deployments_detail.value: early-adopter users saved at least 20 minutes per use case; 97% of surveyed users wanted to continue using it daily

Kerry Trendspotter — predictive AI platform (IBM Watson NLU/ML) that ingests millions of social/consumer data points to forecast food & beverage trends and inform new product development; used to create a novel snack flavour ahead of trend. [IBM Watson]

Kerry Kalaido — proprietary generative-AI product ideation and concepting tool that generates, formulates and visualizes product prototypes from Kerry's 20-year formulation database plus external consumer/trend data; deployed at Kerry co-creation hubs (California), with customers taking outputs to launch activity. [Kerry (proprietary)]
